title: Crickets and saddles.
officialText:
A cricket or saddle shall be installed on the ridge side of any chimney or penetration greater than 30
inches (762 mm) wide as measured perpendicular to the slope. Cricket or saddle coverings shall be sheet metal or of the same material
as the roof covering.
SECTION BC 1504
PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS
